description.fun: Slakoth lolls about sleeping for more than twenty hours a day, which makes everyone around it drowsy too. Moving so little, it needs only three leaves a day, and its heart beats just once a minute. It keeps the same nest its whole life, though it can travel far by swimming down rivers. Ken Sugimori says its name came before its design.
description.guide: A Normal-type sloth Pokémon that sleeps more than twenty hours a day and eats very little. It lives in one nest all its life. It evolves into Vigoroth at level 18 and Slaking at level 36.
description.tagline: A sloth that sleeps twenty hours a day on three leaves

description.fun: Vigoroth is everything Slakoth isn't: its heart beats ten times faster, it can't sit still for even a minute, and trying to rest or sleep only stresses it out. It goes berserk with its arms whirling, smashing whatever is in its path, and all that rampaging leaves it permanently hungry. Even when it looks fast asleep, it can't sleep deeply.
description.guide: A Normal-type Pokémon, the middle stage of the Slakoth line, that is restless and hyperactive. It rampages with its arms whirling and is always hungry. It evolves into Slaking at level 36.
description.tagline: A hyperactive sloth that simply can't sit still

description.fun: Slaking is considered the laziest Pokémon of all: it lounges around eating whatever grass and fallen fruit it can reach, and only moves when there's nothing left within arm's length. But all that lounging saves up energy, which it can release in one terrifying burst. Its family tells a story: lazy Slakoth gets motivated as Vigoroth, then decides it isn't worth it.
description.guide: A large Normal-type Pokémon, the final form of Slakoth, resembling a giant ground sloth crossed with a gorilla. It spends most of the day lying around but has immense strength. Its Japanese name, Kekking, mixes 'absent from work' with 'king'.
description.tagline: The laziest Pokémon, saving its strength for one huge burst
